correctness.rationale: Heawood as Fano incidence graph has 14 vertices/21 edges/girth6 and sufficiently subdivided essentials for ordered 2-particle Abrams model. Independently enumerate ordered cubical D2 cells (182 vertices,504 edges,336 squares); construct F2 boundary columns using graph endpoints and product face rule, verify d1d2=0 columnwise. Exact ranks rank d1=181, rank d2=307, yielding b0=1, b1=504−181−307=16, b2=336−307=29 and χ=14=1−16+29. The computation is exhaustive for the finite cubical model; the Abrams deformation retraction transfers it to continuous ordered F2(H), not automatically to unordered or other particle counts.
